pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high-frequency jagged edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank are significantly larger in spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented patches on the posterior and lower flank. Edges show sharp pixel transitions between dark and light tones.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pathways with clear tri- and quadri-directional junction nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively thin and consistent on the upper flank, widening into more expansive light regions toward the ventral area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged line along the neck and shoulder. The silhouette shows consistent vertical pixel extensions against the background.
